name: Songnim

discovery.english: No first-party DPRK Songnim cadastral/parcel registry or public parcel API was found. The discovered North Korea information portal is a general map and place-search service.
discovery.native: 조선민주주의인민공화국 송림시의 공식 지적·필지 서비스 또는 공개 필지 API를 확인하지 못했다. 확인된 북한정보포털은 일반 지도·지명 검색 서비스이다.

custodian.role: No local Songnim registry custodian was evidenced. South Korean government land services found in discovery were excluded as out-of-country sources.

attemptedRoutes.result: HTTP 200 HTML. Official Ministry of Unification North Korea information portal map shell was fetched; it exposes place/facility search but no public parcel layer, native parcel ID schema, CRS, or anonymous geometry response in the bounded inspection.
Same official general map portal found through Korean-language discovery; no Songnim-specific cadastral endpoint or parcel response was exposed.

HTTP 200. Republic of Korea Ministry of Land viewer shell exposes land/parcel map functions and current JavaScript configuration, including Korean K-GeoP API/layer hosts. It is an ROK service, not a DPRK/KP source, so no Songnim request was issued and no geometry was retained.
Official ROK K-GeoP result confirms Korean land-information services only; it does not establish any KP registry or Songnim coverage and was excluded from qualification.

schemaCrs.details: No qualifying DPRK parcel response was obtained; native field schema, CRS, geometry encoding, and stable parcel identity remain unverified.

allowlist: safe stable native parcel identifier if publicly returned
source field names and mapping in metadata only

geometryReview.reason: No qualifying first-party DPRK anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was found; no GeoJSON sample is retained.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [38.7464338707418, 125.63321322274] is preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was treated as evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
The North Korea information portal was treated as general map/place information, not as a local registry or parcel source.
Republic of Korea K-GeoP results and endpoints were explicitly excluded because the queue record is KP.
No credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private tokens, owner/address/contact, titleholder, tax, account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion records executed research attempts only; it does not qualify an adapter or admit a source.

qualification.uncertainty: High: a DPRK local cadastral custodian, public viewer/API, native identifier, CRS, geometry availability, and citywide coverage were not publicly verified.
